svg.title: PC-12 GENERAL ARRANGEMENT - LAYOUT
svg.desc: PC12-L4 rev A, 1:50, A1. RECONSTRUCTION FROM PUBLISHED DATA - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION.

g.text: RECONSTRUCTION FROM PUBLISHED DATA - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION
SEEN FROM ABOVE · STARBOARD UP · SCALE 1:50
SEEN FROM AHEAD · STARBOARD LEFT · SCALE 1:50
WINGLET + RADAR POD, SEEN FROM AHEAD · 1:10
DEVIATIONS FROM THE PILATUS DRAWING (mm / deg; D = ours - dwg)
root chord solved for 25.81 m2 total plan area
airfoil fuller aft than the drawn WR sections
straight part lengthened for the 16.28 m span
nose-circle centre of the drawn rudder
straight top edge from FR33, 0.134 m/m
wheelbase 3480 (POH) centred on the drawn axles
starboard wing tip; rev A at BL 3900
not modelled: Stage 3 (thrust line 2 deg down)
D DWG vs the registered drawing 190.10.40.432 (sheet 1; x +/-21, z +/-2); REV A = the model before this refit.
WING span over winglets / plan area
root chord BL 0 / tip rib BL 7430
QC WL at BL 0 / incidence root / tip
winglet cant / bend R / top chord
STAB LE / TE at BL 0, chord plane WL
POD radar pod axis BL / WL / R
build.py verify(): 'Wing reference area' must use wing.planform_area() (total projected area incl. the aileron kink and the winglets'
plan projection = 25.81); the trapezoid formula now reads 25.08.
Wing moved 130-160 mm aft and up (flat centre section WL 1036 at the QC, 6.15 deg dihedral from BL 700): details.belly_fairing
(drawn wing-root fairing STA ~5200-8550, bottom WL ~870) must enclose the centre section (lower surface WL 869 at BL 0);
interior.build_structure spar frames / carry-through and the cabin floor (L1: WL 1259) vs the wing upper surface at BL 0 (WL 1251, 8
Flap inboard end now BL 450 (drawn dashed under the fuselage): the fuselage / belly fairing needs a flap well, or keep the 3-D flap
from BL 800. Drawn flap shroud lip at ~93 % chord, flap LE ~70 % (FLAP_X_LIP 0.745 in the cove geometry); aileron chord is a
constant 440 mm in the drawing (AIL_XH fixed at 68.5 %, +/-30 mm).
Airfoil reconstructions (model/airfoil.py) are fuller aft than the drawn WR sections (max thickness at ~30-35 % c): retune; outboard
sections read ~1-2 % too thick in the front view.
Winglet: new sections (wing.winglet_sections); nav / strobe lights belong in the winglet tip (drawn light box at the winglet top),
details.py still places them at the tip rib (inside the pod on starboard).
Gear: main trunnion WL 1070 keeps the ~1 in retracted tyre protrusion with the moved wing (well centre bays.WELL at BL 1474);
re-check retraction clearances to the spars, the leg door (drawn 690 x 760) and brace kinematics (MAIN_BRACE / NOSE_BRACE);
Empennage: fin NACA 0018 down to WL 1760 (the ventral part below the tail cone is the drawn ventral fin); trim the fuselage tail
cone at the fin / rudder, model the ventral fairing (FR40 bump) and the elevator horn balance (E.ELEV_HORN, now part of the fixed
Propeller: the drawing's disc is tilted 2.0 deg top-forward (thrust line 2 deg nose-down) and drawn at STA 925 (PROP_X 800): not
modelled - it needs the engine, mount, inlet and cowl joint re-aligned together.
CLAUDE.md: update the wing facts (planform from the drawing, LEMAC 5462 / MAC 1724, dihedral 6.15 deg, radar pod at the
Drawn from the parameters of model/wing.py, empennage.py, gear.py, bays.py, details.py and fuselage.py (section
functions and knot tables), never from the mesh. STA = mm aft of the datum (3000 ahead of the firewall); WL above
the static ground line; BL + starboard.
Positions fitted to the registered Pilatus NGX model drawing 190.10.40.432 (plan, side, front, sections WR1-4,
VF1-2, HF1-2, FR38 / FR40); photos confirm the radar pod at the starboard wing tip.
Official values kept where the drawing differs: span 16.28 (drawn 16.137), wheelbase 3.48 (drawn 3.515), prop
Wing area 25.81 m2 = total projected plan area (both halves through the fuselage, incl. the aileron kink and the
winglets' plan projection): the drawing's planform gives it within 0.1 %.
WHAT IT SHOWS FOR THE LAYOUT
radar pod on the STARBOARD WING TIP leading edge, black radome, body faired into the winglet root
PRO pod at the starboard tip; radome slightly larger (12-in GWX 8000) -> R 165 (drawn NGX 155)
pod at the starboard tip; LE band slopes 5.7 / 6.6 deg (mean ~6.1 = drawn wing, not the 5.0 dim line)
winglet straight part ~39 deg above horizontal (cant ~51 deg), rise ~0.33 m above the tip
large single leg door on the main leg, trailing link, three flap-track canoes per wing
